exposure: vaginal spontaneous birth subsequent to CD
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) rate
cohort: 131,629 births in Hesse, Germany, from 1990 to 2012 with at least one previous cesarean delivery
finding: The rate of VBAC in Hesse, Germany, decreased significantly from 1990 to 2012, while the rate of repeated cesarean delivery increased.
mod_finding: This study found a continuous decrease in vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) over a 23-year period.
